scopeCorrection.newWorkIdentity: surface expansion of the existing civic pavilion ensemble and its outdoor grounds above/east of Ravensgate
scopeCorrection.prohibition: Do not create or imply a Ravensgate district expansion.

surfaceMasterplan.rule: The x=20 edge is a landscape transition. Preserve the existing woodland beyond it except for exact reviewed path connections.

surfaceObjects.name: Central Russian-referenced civic pavilion
surfaceObjects.relationship: open, non-glass civic hinge: expanded library west; Great Guild Hall east
surfaceObjects.architecture: original Minecraft adaptation using a symmetrical masonry arcade, steep metal roof, central lantern/cupola, patterned soffit and integrated statuary
surfaceObjects.prohibition: Do not rebuild the retired glass pavilion.

surfaceObjects.name: North reflecting pool
surfaceObjects.rule: Closed enumerated basin; no broad fill and no underground connection.

surfaceObjects.name: South reflecting pool
surfaceObjects.rule: Closed enumerated basin; no broad fill and no underground connection.

surfaceObjects.name: Buckingham-Fountain-inspired civic fountain
surfaceObjects.program: large tiered sculptural basin, cardinal sculptural groups, timed-looking static jet composition and evening lighting
surfaceObjects.referenceRule: Original adaptation of Beaux-Arts centerpiece and light/water-display principles; not a literal copy.

surfaceObjects.name: Lincoln-Memorial-inspired civic monument
surfaceObjects.program: raised terrace, broad approach steps and ramps, restrained Doric colonnade, central seated civic figure and reciprocal axis
surfaceObjects.referenceRule: Original commemorative design; do not reproduce inscriptions or represent the structure as the real Lincoln Memorial.

surfaceObjects.name: Tree-line allée and flower walk
surfaceObjects.program: paired trees, four-season flower beds, benches, banners, lighting and east-edge promenade

surfaceObjects.name: Pavilion and grounds statuary
surfaceObjects.rule: Every plinth keeps five clear walking blocks and preserves the library–pavilion–Guild Hall axis.

verticalBuffer.rule: No civilian room, library/Guild tunnel, portal route, utility or foundation penetration.

horizontalReviewBuffer.rule: Any target in this buffer at y<=43 needs explicit restricted-facility conflict review.

restrictedUnderground.accessPolicy: No authorized access point is confirmed in this package. The exclusion remains sealed. Any future deliberate access must be separately surveyed, named, and built with two sequential metal-door vestibules; it may not share the civilian tunnel.

rooms.name: Restricted and challenged-materials archive
rooms.program: closed stacks, catalog desk, supervised reading table and conservation cabinet

rooms.name: Private adult-literature archive
rooms.program: non-explicit adult collection, privacy vestibule, closed stacks and small reading room

rooms.name: Ukrainian-metro-inspired ceremonial station chamber
rooms.program: small three-vault/pylon-inspired hall, symbolic island platform, white/gray stone and green accent, civic mosaic and destination board
rooms.prohibition: Ceremonial room only: no rail, no active transit, no route beyond the Guild Hall/library tunnel.

entryConcealment.guildHall: concealed behind a guild-records screen in the B1/B2 circulation core
